{{Quote|Incoming starship.|The scanner operator when the ''Tyrant'' was approaching the ''Champion''|<ref name="TPOVLSC" />}}
An '''individual''' was serving as a [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] operator and [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the Empire and Alliance on and above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="TPOVLSC" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.</ref> the individual was serving on board the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] [[Champion (Mon Calamari cruiser)|''Champion'']]. As the ''Champion'' was about to leave Hoth, the scanner operator picked up an incoming [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on sensors. The starship was further identified by [[Unidentified Rebel scanner operator 2 (Champion)|three]] [[Unidentified Rebel scanner operator 3 (Champion)|other]] [[Unidentified Rebel technician (Champion)|technicians]] as the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Tyrant'', [[Xamuel Lennox]], ordered the [[Unidentified Rebel captain|Captain]] of the ''Champion'' to hand over Rebellion [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], who had been recently rescued from the ''Tyrant'' by Rebel [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. The ''Champion''{{'s}} captain refused to comply, starting a battle in which the ''Champion'' eventually escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and reached the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebels' rendezvous point]].<ref name="TPOVLSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel scanner operator briefly appeared in the mission text of the third scenario of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] campaign from ''[[The Price of Victory]]'', which was released in [[2010]] as the eighth set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="TPOVLSC" />
